title: T1586.002 — Compromise Accounts - Email Accounts
subtitle: Watch one attacker take over a work mailbox in 8 steps - and see what defenders can notice at each step.
aria: Animated diagram of the attack story. A full text version follows in the written steps below.

steps.title: Buy leaked passwords
steps.caption: The attacker buys a list of stolen email passwords from a criminal market.
steps.defender: None. Lists circulate from old breaches and info-stealer infections, outside company systems.

fields.detail: The attacker buys a list of stolen email passwords from a criminal market.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Credential stuffing on webmail
steps.caption: The attacker replays the list against the webmail login. One password still works and the session opens.
steps.defender: A burst of failed sign-ins from one IP (the numeric address of a device on the internet), then one success. Impossible-travel risk engines may flag it.

fields.detail: The attacker replays the list against the webmail login. One password still works and the session op

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Hide with an inbox rule
steps.caption: The attacker creates an inbox rule that moves security and quarantine mail into a hidden folder.
steps.defender: A New-InboxRule audit event appears. This is the single best early signal of a taken mailbox.

fields.detail: The attacker creates an inbox rule that moves security and quarantine mail into a hidden folder.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Harvest the mailbox
steps.caption: The attacker searches and reads mail in bulk: threads, invoices, contacts, and contracts.
steps.defender: MailItemsAccessed events spike (needs E5 licensing), or volume anomalies show up in other mailbox telemetry.

fields.detail: The attacker searches and reads mail in bulk: threads, invoices, contacts, and contracts.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Reply inside a real thread
steps.caption: The attacker adds a short, believable reply with a malicious link to an ongoing conversation.
steps.defender: The mail gateway sees unusual external sends from an internal account. Recipients start reporting odd replies.

fields.detail: The attacker adds a short, believable reply with a malicious link to an ongoing conversation.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Set forwarding to exfiltrate
steps.caption: The attacker adds a forwarding rule that copies incoming mail to an outside mailbox they own.
steps.defender: A new forwarding rule to an external domain is created. Most tenants alert on this as high severity.

fields.detail: The attacker adds a forwarding rule that copies incoming mail to an outside mailbox they own.

detection.label: Partial signal
detection.detail: A weak signal exists but is not yet a confirmed alert.

steps.title: Chain password resets
steps.caption: The attacker uses reset links in the mailbox to take over the user's bank, payroll, and other accounts.
steps.defender: Reset notices pile up in the mailbox. Changes on external services are not logged by the company.

fields.detail: The attacker uses reset links in the mailbox to take over the user's bank, payroll, and other accoun

detection.label: Alert raised
detection.detail: The SOC has enough evidence to open an incident.

steps.title: SOC response
steps.caption: The SOC revokes sessions, resets the password, purges rules, and warns the people who got malicious mail.
steps.defender: Mail flow rules are purged, sessions revoked, and recipients warned. A tenant-wide hunt for more rules follows.

fields.detail: The SOC revokes sessions, resets the password, purges rules, and warns the people who got malicious

detection.label: Contained
detection.detail: The activity is contained and the lesson is captured.
